tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-full

size.note: Fixed sizes that aren't on the spacing scale.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: The touch target: the least drawn size or hit area of a control under touch sizing, @media (pointer: coarse), (max-width: 639px).

breakpoint.note: For reference only: media queries can't read custom properties, so rules write the width directly, for example max-width: 639px for phone width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Phone width is anything narrower: @media (max-width: 639px). Touch sizing applies below it.
